subject: GreenStitch onboarding — handoff & initial scope
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GreenStitch onboarding — handoff & initial scope

Team —

GreenStitch (Navin / Ellen) signed last night. Quick context: they committed to a 12-month Dedicated plan (6 reserved GPU nodes, burst to 10) for an internal generative search product. Primary success metrics: 95th pct latency < 120ms for common queries and token cost reduction of 20% via batching/quantization within the first 60 days. They are in the US-east region and will be moving sensitive PII workloads into the service, so Private deployment is on the roadmap but the initial go-live is Hosted + Dedicated pool.

Key commercial items: SOC2 in progress (they requested evidence), and procurement needs the signed SOW and a simple redline to the MSA (procurement@greenstitch.com copied). I attached the SOW and the mutual action plan we agreed on.

Immediate asks:
- Can CS own the kickoff and technical intake? I recommend assigning Tessa as primary implementation owner and Ben as tech lead for deployment and performance tuning.
- Proposed kickoff window: May 5–7. Navin prefers mornings PST.
- Risk: they will need a data residency discussion if they move to Private. Flag for Security.

Marissa, Tessa, Ben — please confirm owners, initial intake agenda, and any prerequisites to share with Navin before the kickoff.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Attachment: GreenStitch_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf), GreenStitch_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (xlsx)

Subject: Re: GreenStitch onboarding — handoff & initial scope

Thanks Kim — congrats team. I can take point on the kickoff coordination and run the intake, with Tessa as the implementation lead.

Owners (confirmed):
- Primary CS owner / kickoff coordinator: Marissa Cole (I will schedule and run the first two sessions)
- Implementation lead / deployment owner: Tessa Morgan (primary for runbooks, org setup, and acceptance criteria)
- Technical performance lead: Ben Carter (latency tuning, batching, quant profiles)

Initial intake agenda (30–45m):
1) Introductions + success criteria (Navin)
2) High-level architecture & data flows (GreenStitch)
3) Timeline & milestones (go-live target: May 28)
4) Security & compliance checklist (SOC2 items & data residency intent)
5) Action items & ownership (MAP review)

Prereqs for Navin before the kickoff:
- Confirm list of internal stakeholders (dev, infra, security).
- Provide a sample query profile (peak qps, avg seq length) or a short trace file (if possible).
- Share procurement contact for SOW acceptance.

I will send a calendar invite for May 6 at 10:00 AM PST and include a short intake form for the stakeholders to complete. Ben — can you prepare a brief note on what performance telemetry we need (KV cache size estimates, expected token lengths) and any sandbox requirements?

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Great — I’ll own performance intake. Navin / Ellen: thanks in advance for the sample workload. To streamline the first technical session I need:
- A CSV of representative prompts/queries (10–50 rows) with avg token length and peak QPS if available.
- Typical sequence length distribution (or a note if all are short prompts).
- Any current inference infra (are you running on GCP/OCI/AWS internally?) and restrictions for outbound connections to a sandbox.

Pre-kickoff deliverable from my side: a 1-pager that lists sandbox requirements, telemetry hooks we’ll ask you to enable, and a preliminary quantization/batching recommendation matrix based on expected throughput.

Attachment (for internal team): onboarding-checklist.md (reference)

All set — confirmed kickoff for May 6, 2027 at 10:00 AM PST (calendar invite sent). Agenda attached in the invite; brief notes below:

Kickoff action items (owners & 48h SLAs):
- Navin / Ellen: complete intake form and upload sample queries — due May 3 (owner: GreenStitch)
- Procurement@greenstitch.com: confirm SOW acceptance or provide redline — due May 4
- Ben: share sandbox requirements doc (internal) — due Apr 30 EOD (done)
- Marissa: prepare runbook template and acceptance criteria doc — due May 5

Risks we flagged in the call: potential SOC2 evidence lag (I’ll loop Security if we get into doc requests), and possible need for Private deployment if their compliance team insists on dedicated VPC. If that happens, we’ll need to escalate capacity planning.

Navin — please reply if the May 6 time doesn't work. Otherwise, we'll use the intake form to collect the small items before the call so the kickoff can focus on timeline and responsibilities.

Thanks — I’ll drive the implementation timeline and update the internal sprint board after the kickoff.
